config.label: Path to the
config.description: Path to the .env file that states the destination (the same as the --env-path argument). The file states SAP_URL and SAP_AUTH_TYPE (basic, snc or jwt); a jwt file also states SAP_GRANT_TYPE (authorization_code or none). Without this or --mcp, the server starts in tool-inspection-only mode: nothing is read from the working directory, and SAP_* variables in the process environment alone form no destination.

config.label: Base directory of service-keys/ and sessions/ for a named destination chosen with the --mcp argument (one directory; a list is not split)
config.description: Base directory of service-keys/ and sessions/ for a named destination chosen with the --mcp argument (one directory; a list is not split). Default: ~/.config/mcp-abap-adt (Documents\mcp-abap-adt on Windows).

config.label: Browser for a JWT login: chrome, edge, firefox, system, headless or none
config.description: Browser for a JWT login: chrome, edge, firefox, system, headless or none.

config.label: Callback port of the JWT browser login, 1-65535
config.description: Callback port of the JWT browser login, 1-65535.

config.description: Write a named destination's session to disk (sessions/<name>.env) instead of keeping it in memory.

config.label: Connection type: http or rfc
config.description: Connection type: http or rfc. SNC needs rfc (and the SAP NW RFC SDK).

config.description: System type, required (here or as --system-type; no default, never guessed): the tools offered (e.g. Programs are onprem-only), the connector, and how the system's answers are read. Without it a destination does not start.
